sourceTitle: The Messiah in Moses and the Prophets
description: "The Messiah in Moses and the Prophets" by Eleazar Lord is a religious treatise written in the mid-19th century. This work explores the connections between the concept of the Messiah in the Old Testament and the figure of Jesus Christ in the New Testament, emphasizing the idea that the appearances of God in the Old Testament scriptures are manifestations of the Messiah.
